My beans do not need plenty of chemical fertilizer like maize — they feed the soil themselves. I will put the manure from my small animals on the plot before planting, and keep my own seed from last harvest because I know it grows well here. The insects trouble cowpea very much in this place, so I must buy some spray, otherwise the pods will be empty. I will do most of the work myself with my family, but at weeding and harvest time I will call a few people to help me because my total farm is big.
